# Chip Shots

> Chip Shots is a restaurant and bar with indoor golf in east Henderson, Nevada, at 1473 E Lake Mead Pkwy, Suite 110, Henderson, NV 89015. It has a full kitchen, a full bar and five TrackMan golf simulator bays. Phone: (725) 377-8872. Website: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com

## Hours
- Monday to Friday: 11 AM to 10 PM
- Saturday and Sunday: 10 AM to 10 PM

## Brunch
- Prime rib brunch buffet on the first and third Sundays of every month, 10 AM to 1 PM.
- Prime rib carving station, breakfast favorites and more.
- Adults $35, kids 6 to 12 $17, kids 5 and under free. Bottomless mimosas and Bloody Marys $15.
- Walk-ins welcome; a reservation holds your table.
- NFL Sunday Ticket on every screen during brunch.
- Details and dates: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/brunch

## Food and drink
- Lunch and dinner every day: burgers, wings, shareables, sandwiches and shakes, plus craft drafts, wine and cocktails.
- Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3 PM to 6 PM.
- Pickup ordering online, and delivery through DoorDash and Uber Eats.
- Menu: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/food-drink

## Sports and events
- College football, NFL Sunday Ticket and other games on the screens over the bar and on the TV in every golf bay.
- Trivia night every Tuesday, 6:30 PM to 8 PM, free to play.
- Private events from a single bay to a full buyout, including holiday parties and corporate events: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/events

## Indoor golf
- Five climate-controlled TrackMan simulator bays, booked by the hour, up to four players per bay. Clubs are provided and no golf experience is needed.
- $40 per hour off-peak and $50 per hour at peak times, per bay.
- Memberships include bay time: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/memberships
- Book a bay: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/golf-booking

## More
- FAQ: https://www.chipshotshenderson.com/faq
